posts.zh:
dsh-role-router 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d89373954c85f4fc9871.html
posts.en:
dsh-role-router is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d89373954c85f4fc9871.html
